name: Pocket Sand! | Chapter 2 Starter Guide
description_md:
Pocket Sand!

>This series provides 10 playtested decks using the Chapter 2 Core and new Starters, with each deck compatible for two player with at least 7 others (and working well at high player counts). Rather than cowering from the [Black Chamber Operative](/card/12009), Trish uses pocket sand (or [Caustic Reaction](/card/60261) if you want to get technical) and [pushing him off a roof](/card/60378) to excellent effect! She even hunts the Operative out of her deck with [Mysterious Grimoire](/card/12040) - a bold move if I ever saw one... `If you want to support my work, give it a like ❤︎ and a favorite ★ on here!`

Series Decks

|   Mystic   |   Rogue   |   Guardian   |   Survivor   |   Seeker   | |:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:| | Marie | André | Tommy| Miguel | Carolyn | | Dexter | Trish | Daniela | Izzie | Joe |

At a Glance

>| Stats | | >|:---|:---| >| Clue-finding: |  ★★★★★ | >| Consistency: |  ★★★★☆ | >| Enemy Management: |  ★★★★☆ | >| Encounter Defense: |  ★★☆☆☆ | >| Survivability: |  ★★★★☆ | >| Simplicity: |  ★★★★★ |

Overview

- Trish bites back: [Caustic Reaction](/card/60261) is a great way to deal with [Black Chamber Operative](/card/12009), coming in at a 6 test with [Dorothy Simmons](/card/12030) and being very readily boostable with the 27 icons present. If you can evade the Operative, then upgraded [A Sudden Fall](/card/60378) allows you to fight with (and add ) to kill him outright. This deck also has a number of ways delay the Operative, with [Unflappable](/card/60271), [Pay Your Dues](/card/60365) and [Breaking and Entering](/card/12050) facilitating evades and/or disengagement. Of course, these can be used on non-Operative enemies too! - I spy something being with "C"... it's clues: With [Dorothy Simmons](/card/12030) plus [Magnifying Glass](/card/12034), Trish investigates at an effective 6 (7 if you use a second Magnifying Glass). With her extra action to evade and [Olivier](/card/12046)'s move, she tends to have plenty of spare actions to find clues. [Working a Hunch](/card/12038) and [Deduction](/card/60267) allow for clue compression. - Hazardous card draw: With Trish's more trivial enemy management options, [Mysterious Grimoire](/card/12040) becomes a good contender for drawing cards. Pair this to [Covert Ops](/card/12008) and cantrips like [Perception](/card/12093) and [Manual Dexterity](/card/12091), and the deck turns over quite nicely. The Grimoire is only purchased *after* better enemy management options come into the deck - you should always upgrade responsibly! - Soak and healing: [Olivier](/card/12046) provides damage soak, both Olivier and [Dorothy](/card/12030) provide emergency horror soak, and [Unflappable](/card/60271) now provides horror healing - with the upgraded version healing 2 horror through a boosted evade action. This makes the deck significantly sturdier than using the Chapter 2 core alone. - Encounter management: This deck is still weaker on encounter deck management, but it does have 9 (and generally treacheries aren't a concern). What you lose in encounter management you gain in good enemy management and clue-finding. Thank you: [5argon](https://arkhamdb.com/user/profile/61394/5argon) and [their thumbnail tool](https://arkham-starter.com/tool/thumbnails); [Valentin1331](https://arkhamdb.com/user/profile/42890/Valentin1331) for his support over the years; the community creators of [Arkham.Build](https://www.patreon.com/c/arkhambuild/) ([Felix](https://spoettel.dev/)), [Arkham Cards](https://www.patreon.com/c/arkhamcards/) ([zzorba](https://www.reddit.com/user/zzorba/)) and [ArkhamDB](https://www.patreon.com/c/kamalisk/) ([kamalisk](https://www.reddit.com/user/kamalisk/)) - linking their Patreons!

Explain Yourself!

The deck is in essence a tooled up version of my original Chapter 2 deck, this time containing new enemy management options which have come with the starter decks. Due to enemy management now being a little easier - you're less fearful of [Black Chamber Operative](/card/12009) and so can take [Mysterious Grimoire](/card/12040). Mysterious Grimoire means you're less hurt by the lack of [Lucky Cigarette Case](/card/12044), which is in André's deck. This deck does lack many of the new Rogue resource cards, however with [Another Day, Another Dollar](/card/12056) you can solve this problem actionlessly by starting with more cash up front (and then [Emergency Cache](/card/12089) plus [Dorothy](/card/12030) keep you going otherwise). Even with just one copy of Another Day, you can typically play a good chunk of your engine using it and your starting resources.

Campaign starter and planned progression

For a deck variant with [Lucky Cigarette Case](/card/12044) and [Out the Door](/card/60373), please see this link. LCC is obviously a very popular card for good reason, and while I don't think you really need both LCC and [Mysterious Grimoire](/card/12040) I thought I'd provide the option! 0 XP deck is below (and link here): A recommended order of purchases/upgrades is: - 1 x [Another Day, Another Dollar](/card/12056) - 1 x [Charisma](/card/12095) - [M1903 Hammerless](/card/12045) → [A Sudden Fall ••](/card/60378) - [Gather Intel](/card/12036) → [Mysterious Grimoire](/card/12040) - 1 x [Another Day, Another Dollar](/card/12056) - [Unflappable](/card/60262) → [Unflappable •](/card/60271) Post-19 XP suggestions are: - [Unexpected Courage](/card/12094) → [Right Under Their Noses •••](/card/60382) - [Deduction](/card/60267) → [Deduction ••](/card/60275)

Compatability Matrix

Everyone likes a good matrix! Below are all the decks that are compatible at two player using one Chapter 2 Core and one 2026 Starter Deck set: For higher player counts I've not 'compatabilized' the basic skills ([Overpower](/card/12092), [Manual Dexterity](/card/12091), [Guts](/card/12090), [Perception](/card/12093) and [Unexpected Courage](/card/12094)). There are only 4 copies of each in the Chapter 2 core, enough for any two decks. If playing 3+ players and there's a clash, you can either: - Swap with an appropriate level 0 class skill which that deck can use (e.g. [On the Brink](/card/60569) for [Unexpected Courage](/card/12094)). - Swap with a class event or asset with matching or similar symbols (e.g. [Working a Hunch](/card/12038) for [Perception](/card/12093)). - Swap with a different underused basic skill you still believe would be useful for the deck (e.g. [Guts](/card/12090) for [Unexpected Courage](/card/12094)). - Proxy however you see fit (especially if you own Chapter 1 cards, just use the old school versions and remember the slight difference around who draws the card). I empower you to do sensible things!

Final thoughts

With the Chapter 2 box only, I think Trish's options to deal with [Black Chamber Operative](/card/12009) were quite limited. That all changed with the new starters! This deck keeps what was already good about Trish - e.g. running [Olivier](/card/12046) and [Dorothy](/card/12030) simultaneously - but then adds in horror healing, more enemy management options and [Mysterious Grimoire](/card/12040). The latter is now appropriately de-risked so you can use it somewhat "comfortably" - but there will be times when the Operative still catches you off-guard. The feeling of always looking over your shoulder when playing Trish is certainly on-theme! Any thoughts - drop them below!
